description:
Complete a child inscription - STEP 2: Broadcast reveal transaction.

Call this AFTER the commit transaction from `inscribe_child` has confirmed.
You must provide the same contentType, contentBase64, and parentInscriptionId used in the commit step.

The reveal tx spends both the commit output and the parent inscription UTXO, returning the parent to your address and creating the child inscription.

Returns: inscriptionId ({revealTxid}i0), parentInscriptionId on success

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

commitTxid.description: Transaction ID of the confirmed commit transaction (from inscribe_child)

contentBase64.description: Content as base64-encoded string (must match the commit step)

contentType.description: MIME type (must match the commit step)

feeRate.description: Fee rate for reveal tx (default: medium)

parentInscriptionId.description: Parent inscription ID (must match the commit step)

revealAmount.description: Amount in the commit output (from inscribe_child response)

name: inscribe_child_reveal
